notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome only. robots.txt is a standard Shopify storefront file (Allow: /) with Shopify agent/UCP boilerplate urging installation of a shopping skill for checkout - ignored as out-of-scope injected instruction; this was read-only extraction, no cart/checkout touched. No ClaudeBot/Claude-User disallow. Site has NO single top-level 'Furniture' nav item; furniture is scattered across room departments (Living, Dining, Outdoor, Bedroom, Workspace) alongside non-furniture Lighting/Decor/Kitchen departments - matches the prior Home-Decor pass's note that the room tree carries furniture branches it deliberately excluded. TREE SOURCE: full mega-menu DOM scan (158 unique /collections/ links present in DOM, most hidden by CSS until hover) plus mandatory sitemap_collections_1.xml cross-check (brief trap #1). QTY METHOD: /collections/<handle>/products.json paginated to exhaustion (limit=250) with unique product handles counted = rule-4 'full enumeration'. Corroborated against the site's own rendered 'Showing X of Y' header (rule 1) on two samples spanning the size range - All Sofas: header 'Showing 1-40 of 1182' vs products.json 1182 (exact match); Beds: header 'Showing 1-16 of 16' vs products.json 16 (exact match) - so products.json is trusted as equal to the rendered header on this storefront, consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's finding for this exact site. TRAP #1 SITEMAP CROSS-CHECK: sitemap listed several furniture-shaped slugs not present in the live nav (sofas, outdoor-chairs, outdoor-tables, arm-chairs, bar-cabinets, office-chairs, room-dividers, media-stands, household-storage, shelving). Checked every one by product-handle-set comparison: 'sofas' (476) is a 100% subset of nav-linked 'all-sofas' (1182); 'office-chairs' (21) is a 100% subset of nav-linked 'desk-chairs' (474); 'bar-cabinets' (4) is a 100% subset of nav-linked 'cabinets-and-cupboards' (78); 'room-dividers' (16) is a 100% subset of nav-linked 'acoustic-panels-room-dividers' (20); 'outdoor-chairs', 'outdoor-tables', 'arm-chairs', 'media-stands', 'household-storage', 'shelving' all return 0 products and are unlinked - orphaned/legacy collections. None represent a genuinely distinct or missed furniture branch, so none were emitted as separate rows (would have duplicated an already-emitted node). Kitchen department checked directly (kitchen, kitchen-organization-storage, kitchen-racks, kitchen-cookware, kitchen-linens-tools-utensils, pot-racks) - all cookware/tools/small-storage, zero furniture, consistent with prior Home-Decor pass. EMPTY LIVE CATEGORIES: 'Bar Carts and Serving' (outdoor-bar-carts-serving-stations) and 'Protective Panels and Screens' (protective-panels-screens) are live, correctly-titled, nav-linked pages returning 0 products (verified: protective-panels-screens page shows title 'Protective Panels & Screens - Design Public' and empty-state text 'No results. Use fewer filters or clear all', HTTP 200, not 404) - emitted per rule 7b.4 as leaf rows with qty=0. EXCLUSIONS: all Lighting, Wall Decor/Mirrors/Clocks, Vases/Planters/Figurines/Candles/Hooks-Racks/Baskets (decor/storage), all textiles (Bedding, Throw Pillows/Blankets, Rugs, Seat Pads, Outdoor Rugs/Throws), all tableware/cookware (Tabletop and Bar, Kitchen dept, Dinnerware, Serveware, Flatware, etc.), Wall Shelves and Ledges (wall-decor-department shelving per the shelving-line rule, distinct from the furniture-department 'Bookcases and Standing Shelves' which was kept), Desktop Organization/Office Supplies/Whiteboards (office supplies, not furniture), Fire Pits and Grills/Torches/Umbrellas/Outdoor Accessories (outdoor decor/accessories), all brand-collection pages (rule 3). 'Wine Racks' (1 product, a genuine freestanding wine-rack cabinet) and 'Magazine Racks' (10 products, freestanding floor racks) kept as furniture since the site itself files them under furniture-typed Storage departments (Dining Room Storage / Living Room Storage and Entertainment) rather than a decor/small-storage department, and product samples confirm they are furniture-type items, not standalone containers.
